description:
We are Team Tanyl from Shymkent, Kazakhstan, now joined with team SARWatch for the global round.

We build FireCalendar: NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire data harmonized into one 25-year record, machine-learning fire-risk forecasts, NISAR radar burned-area checks, AI after-fire reports and alerts in Kazakh, Russian and English. Skills: Python, machine learning, remote sensing, web development, design.

Looking for: GIS and radar specialists, emergency-service experts, translators.
